'''Game News & Updates''' in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #13 (October 1996, page 74) is an Inside the Industry news column. Its Star Wars CCG item names the [[Jedi Pack]] and [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]].<ref name="duelist13news" />

[[File:Duelist 13 page 74.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #13, October 1996, page 74.]]

The SWCCG item sits among other Decipher and licensed-game notices on the same page.

<blockquote>
'''Star Wars CCG''' (Decipher): This summer the company produced free 11-card Jedi Packs, in the manner of last year's Warp Packs for Decipher's Star Trek game. The Jedi Pack includes new, less powerful versions of Han Solo and Princess Leia, plus Luke's skyhopper and a Rebel Base Navigation Chart. Distribution information was unavailable at press time, but Decipher's impressive website &lt;<nowiki>www.decipher.com</nowiki>&gt; has details. The next SW:CCG expansion is ''The Empire Strikes Back: Hoth'', first of three 162-card sets based on the second movie. Due in late September or October, ''Hoth'' features new rules covering snowspeeders, AT-AT walkers, and so on. The ''Shadows of the Empire'' expansion is due in late December or January.
</blockquote>
